item.name: Healing potion
item.description: The reason you came this way at all. It is for your sister, and drinking it yourself would be a decision, not an accident. 0 weight; 50 coins.

item.name: Short sword
item.description: Plain, kept sharp, and the only thing standing between you and something eight feet tall. To the ogre it would be a knife. Close; 1 weight; 8 coins.

item.name: Worn bow
item.description: It has seen better seasons. The string has been replaced twice and the belly is scarred, but it still throws an arrow where you point it. Near; 2 weight; 15 coins.

item.name: Arrows
item.description: Few, and you count them more often than you would like. How many are left is something the story tells you, not a number on a sheet. 1 weight; 1 coin.

item.name: Leather armour
item.description: Boiled hide, cracked across the shoulder where it has been worn wet too often. It turns a killing blow into a bruise, sometimes. 1 armour; 1 weight; 10 coins.

item.name: Adventuring gear
item.description: Chalk, poles, spikes, rope, tinder, the small useful things you notice only when they are gone. Rummage through it and you find what the moment needs. 1 weight; 20 coins.

item.name: Dungeon rations
item.description: Hard bread and salted meat, five meals of it, dull enough that you eat it only when you must. 1 weight; 3 coins.

item.name: Three coins
item.description: Every coin you have on you, and not enough to replace a single thing you might lose today. 0 weight.

item.name: Gem
item.description: Four hundred coins of cut stone, taken from the ogre's loincloth. Enough to move your family to the city, if you live to carry it home.
